summary: The simulation core is coherent and syntactically sound, covering agents, locations, policy, media, and a retail supply chain. Recent changes improved structure (SocialNetwork class, better inventory flow, campaign costs, counterfactual guard). However, the implementation diverges from the spec on key entities and metrics: EpidemicContext and risk feedback are missing; network_type=scale_free and homophily are not implemented; several required metrics (information_balance_index, adoption_rate_by_group, supply_shortfall_rate, social_contagion_coefficient) are absent; validation across runs and policy sanity checks are missing; and Person/Location attributes are incomplete. These gaps limit interpretability and policy analysis. The next iteration should prioritize adding the EpidemicContext, implementing the scale-free network, completing metric calculations, and introducing validation harnesses.

critical_issues.issue: Missing EpidemicContext entity and risk/case-rate feedback loop
critical_issues.impact: Breaks the risk_feedback interaction in the spec; prevents policy maker from responding to case thresholds; undermines external risk drivers beyond endogenous prevalence/media.
critical_issues.solution: Add an EpidemicContext dataclass with current_case_rate, case_rate_series, public_risk_signal, update_case_rate/update_risk_signal. Instantiate in Simulation.__init__, update in step(), pass public_risk_signal into Person.perceive_risk, and add threshold_cases_for_policy to PolicyAuthority.issue_mandates.

critical_issues.issue: Network type 'scale_free' and homophily are not implemented; connect_agents always returns small-world
critical_issues.impact: Peer influence structure is not per spec; diffusion dynamics and tail influencers are misrepresented, affecting social contagion and adoption speed.
critical_issues.solution: Add Barabási–Albert scale-free generator and a homophily bias. Honor network_type and homophily_strength in SocialNetwork.connect_agents.

critical_issues.issue: Required metrics missing: information_balance_index, adoption_rate_by_group, supply_shortfall_rate, social_contagion_coefficient
critical_issues.impact: Cannot evaluate communications impact, equity, supply constraints, or peer contagion strength as specified, reducing policy relevance.
critical_issues.solution: Track daily pro vs misinformation reach and compute index; segment adoption by age/income/political_identity; compute supply_shortfall_rate via daily_demand > daily_sold; estimate contagion coefficient via regression of adoption on peer share using a simple OLS coefficient.

critical_issues.issue: No validation framework (stability across runs, convergence, mass balance, policy sanity checks)
critical_issues.impact: Results may be unstable or inconsistent; hard to detect logic errors or inappropriate parameterizations.
critical_issues.solution: Add a multi-run driver honoring num_runs and varying seed; compute coefficient of variation for adoption; implement convergence test; add mass-balance assertions; include policy sanity checks comparing zero-enforcement vs strong mandates.

critical_issues.issue: Spec deviations in Person/Location attributes and denial-of-service handling
critical_issues.impact: Equity/political segmentation not possible; compliance costs/fatigue not represented; policy enforcement lacks denial-of-service, inflating visits/compliance.
critical_issues.solution: Extend Person with political_identity, budget, fatigue, exposure_to_messages; extend Location with type-based contact_rate_modifier. Modify enforcement to optionally deny entry when non-compliant and out of inventory.

critical_issues.issue: Parameter alias gaps (e.g., enforcement_strength, supply_capacity_per_day, stockpile_initial)
critical_issues.impact: User-specified scenarios per spec may be ignored or misinterpreted, leading to confusing behavior.
critical_issues.solution: Add alias handling: enforcement_strength -> enforcement_level, supply_capacity_per_day -> production_rate_per_day, stockpile_initial -> initial_total_stock; and honor network_type.

model_improvements.current_approach: Endogenous prevalence plus optional external prevalence scalar; no case-rate series or policy thresholding.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Add EpidemicContext with daily case rate updates and a public risk signal; feed into Person.perceive_risk and PolicyAuthority.issue_mandates via threshold_cases_for_policy.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: More realistic alignment with epidemic phases; policies and adoption respond to disease dynamics.

model_improvements.current_approach: Small-world network regardless of network_type; no homophily.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Implement BA scale-free generator and homophily bias on attachment by political identity or age group; allow param homophily_strength to vary bias.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Captures influencer hubs and clustering by identity, improving diffusion realism and subgroup dynamics.

model_improvements.current_approach: Aggregate media signal only; no measurement of exposure balance.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Track per-day pro vs anti (misinformation) reach shares and compute information_balance_index series.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Enables testing of campaign intensity and misinformation scenarios against behavior outcomes.

model_improvements.current_approach: Stockouts tracked at retailers; daily demand and sold tracked; no shortfall metric.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Compute supply_shortfall_rate as fraction of days where daily_demand > daily_sold; add to results and validation.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Quantifies constraint intensity and its behavior impact.

model_improvements.current_approach: No explicit estimation; social influence embedded in dynamics only.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Collect panel of peer_share and adoption outcome per day/person and compute OLS coefficient beta=cov(X,Y)/var(X).
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Provides a clear, interpretable measure of social contagion strength.

model_improvements.suggested_approach: Add run_multiple() to execute num_runs with varying seeds; compute stability, convergence, mass balance, and policy sanity results.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Trustworthy outputs and automated sanity checks.

code_improvements.modification: Add EpidemicContext entity and integrate into step() and PolicyAuthority
code_improvements.reason: Implements risk_feedback and policy thresholding per spec; enables case-rate-driven dynamics.

code_improvements.modification: Implement scale_free topology and honor homophily_strength in SocialNetwork.connect_agents
code_improvements.reason: Aligns with spec parameters (network_type='scale_free') and improves diffusion structure realism.

code_improvements.modification: Extend Person with political_identity, budget, fatigue; assign during initialize; segment adoption by group
code_improvements.reason: Enables equity analyses and adoption_rate_by_group metric; allows modeling fatigue effects.

code_improvements.modification: Track information_balance_index and supply_shortfall_rate; compute social_contagion_coefficient via simple regression
code_improvements.reason: Fulfills required metrics; improves interpretability and evaluation.

code_improvements.modification: Add denial-of-service handling in Location.enforce_mask_policy with a denied_entry flag and adjust visit accounting
code_improvements.reason: Matches spec's enforcement outcomes; prevents overcounting of compliant entries and interactions.

code_improvements.modification: Add parameter aliases for enforcement_strength, supply_capacity_per_day, stockpile_initial; ensure network_type parameter is honored
code_improvements.reason: Prevents parameter misinterpretation; improves usability and spec conformance.

code_improvements.modification: Add validation harness: run_multiple() for stability_across_runs; convergence and mass-balance checks; policy sanity checks
code_improvements.reason: Implements validation_criteria; increases reliability of outputs.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: No calibration to empirical adoption trajectories; adoption driven by internal dynamics only.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Allow ingestion of external case rates and observed adoption series; calibrate message_effect_strength and social_influence_weight via minimizing fit_rmse; tune enforcement_strength using policy timelines from data.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: No segmentation by political identity; age/income segmentation partial and not returned.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Assign political_identity based on survey distributions; fit group-specific parameters (trust_in_authorities, misinformation_exposure) to match observed group differences.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: Not computed; media exposure not tied to adoption heterogeneously.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Model heterogeneous reach (e.g., political filter bubbles) by political_identity; compute index per group and test campaign targeting strategies.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: No explicit shortfall metric despite tracked demand/sales.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Return supply_shortfall_rate; calibrate supply_capacity_per_day and restock_rate to match early-pandemic stockout frequencies.

prioritized_actions: Add EpidemicContext and integrate case-rate-driven risk and policy thresholds
Implement network_type='scale_free' in SocialNetwork with optional homophily bias
Compute missing metrics: information_balance_index, adoption_rate_by_group, supply_shortfall_rate, social_contagion_coefficient
Add validation harness (multi-run stability, convergence, mass balance, policy sanity checks)
Extend Person with political_identity/budget/fatigue and add denial-of-service handling in enforcement
Add parameter alias mappings for enforcement_strength, supply_capacity_per_day, stockpile_initial and honor network_type
additional_comments: Recent changes improved architecture (SocialNetwork abstraction, supply-chain integration for retailers, counterfactual guard) and fixed several sequencing issues (daily new adopters baseline). The next iteration should focus on spec completeness and metrics to enable rigorous evaluation. Keep the required direct main() call; optionally make main() run a demo for convenience.

change_analysis.summary: The diff introduces cleaner architecture and fixes several sequencing and accounting issues. It adds SocialNetwork abstraction, draws retailer inventory from the supply chain, fixes daily adopter tracking, constrains retailer pricing, and guards against counterfactual recursion. However, it still lacks key spec entities and metrics, and some parameters are ignored.
positive_impacts: Introduced SocialNetwork class and used it to generate adjacency
Retailers now draw initial stock from SupplyChain (mass balance improved)
Campaign costs handled more realistically (broadcast-only vs always-on modes)
Daily new adopters computed correctly by capturing pre-reset state
Counterfactual policy effectiveness uses an _is_counterfactual guard
negative_impacts: Network topology still defaults to small-world; 'scale_free' ignored
No EpidemicContext; media/external prevalence only approximate risk feedback
suggestions: Implement Barabási–Albert scale-free topology and homophily bias
Add EpidemicContext and integrate case-rate thresholds into mandates
Track information_balance_index and compute supply_shortfall_rate, contagion coefficient
Add validation harness for stability, convergence, and policy sanity checks
